document_metadata.document_title: SWFWMD ERP Applicant's Handbook Volume II (Design Requirements)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: SWFWMD ERP AH Vol II stormwater quality and quantity criteria for systems in the District. Open-basin peak discharge typically analyzed with District 24-hour / 25-year rainfall; closed basins may require 24-hour / 100-year volume matching. Treatment volumes and recovery criteria per Parts IV–VI of Volume II (and Volume I performance standards).
peak_flow_calculation_method: NRCS Type II Florida Modified distribution

evidence.excerpt: City of Lakeland is within SWFWMD and follows ERP AH Volume II
24-hour, 25-year rainfall maps and the Natural Resources Conservation Service type II Florida Modified 24-hour rainfall distribution
The seasonal high water level must be at least one foot below the center line of the perforated pipe
The seasonal high water level must be at least one foot below the bottom of the exfiltration pipe
Credit for the PPV is limited to a maximum depth of 8 feet
The total detention volume shall again be available within 36 hours
sized to discharge ½ inch of detention runoff (mixing volume) from the contributing area in 24 hours

extraction_quality.review_notes: Municipality coverage via SWFWMD ERP AH Vol II. City portal criteria PDF returned HTML/404 previously.

design_parameters.enrich_notes: Treatment volume sizing references Volume I performance standards (not a fixed WQV depth in these excerpts). Wet detention: PPV max credit 8 ft; mixing drawdown ½ in. in 24 hr; overflow max 10 in. above control. Recovery: 36 hr (detention with effluent filtration), 72 hr (on-line/off-line retention and underground exfiltration; only 36 hr volume counts toward quantity). Exfiltration design rate divided by safety factor 2.0. Pretreatment swale: first ¼ in. runoff, max 4 in. overall depth.
